finding_resolutions.explanation: Confirmed: melee-enemy and ranged-enemy each claim delivery of a usable assembled world-space SpriteRenderer prefab following isometric sorting conventions, but world-visual-foundation owns establishing those conventions per GDD Section 5/Section 3 and is repository_state missing with no SpriteRenderer/sorting foundation present anywhere in Assets/. Added a depends_on edge from each archetype to world-visual-foundation (a valid implementation-kind target) rather than narrowing the acceptance criteria, since both items already correctly scope presentation as an integration responsibility.

Confirmed: melee-enemy, ranged-enemy, and locked-door-enemy-attack own attack-side state (melee execution, ranged telegraph/projectile, locked-door attack) that the GDD names as a required restart reset participant, but none carried a reset acceptance/validation criterion, and floor-run-restart-persistent-closure's depends_on list omitted all three. Added matching reset acceptance criteria and validation requirements to each owner and added the three keys to floor-run-restart-persistent-closure's depends_on, mirroring the existing pattern used for pursuit/status/health/registry owners.

Confirmed: encounter-admission-cap-enforcement owns encounter activation/admission state named by the GDD as a required restart reset participant, and floor-run-restart-persistent-closure already depends on it, but it had no reset acceptance criterion or validation requirement of its own. Added both, consistent with the sibling enemy-state owners' pattern; no new dependency edge was needed since the closure item already targets this key.

Confirmed against GDD text: the Loss and Floor-run restart ownership paragraphs state Active Enemy Registry bookkeeping resets to the floor's initial state but never state that initial state is empty, and the floor's initial persistent-enemy set can be non-zero. Corrected the acceptance criterion and validation requirement to drop the invented 'empty' wording in favor of 'floor's initial state,' and added an explicit re-registration/consistency acceptance criterion plus matching validation wording so post-restart registry count cannot desynchronize from the set of live persistent enemies restored by enemy-owned resets.

result.reasoning:
All four supplied findings from the Evidence — Enemies Encounters verifier were independently confirmed against the frozen candidate and the GDD before making any edits.

EV-ENEM-001 (error): Verified melee-enemy and ranged-enemy acceptance criteria text and world-visual-foundation's acceptance criteria/repository_state directly in the candidate — both archetypes claim the identical SpriteRenderer/sorting deliverable that world-visual-foundation owns and that foundation is confirmed missing, with no existing dependency edge recorded. Repaired by adding a depends_on edge to world-visual-foundation (a legal implementation-kind target, not a feature) rather than stripping the archetype acceptance criteria, since narrowing would remove legitimate integration-level acceptance language the candidate already scoped correctly ('integrating... presentation').

EV-ENEM-002 (error): Verified by reading enemy-pursuit-search-foundation, enemy-status-effect-displacement, and enemy-health-damage-defeat's existing reset acceptance/validation criteria (confirming the established pattern), then confirming melee-enemy, ranged-enemy, and locked-door-enemy-attack's full records contain no such criteria, and confirming floor-run-restart-persistent-closure's depends_on list omits all three keys. Repaired by adding matching reset acceptance/validation criteria to each attack-state owner and adding them as reset participants/dependencies of the closure item, mirroring the existing established pattern exactly rather than inventing new representation.

EV-ENEM-003 (error): Verified encounter-admission-cap-enforcement's three acceptance criteria (capacity query, delay/reduce-first, non-duplication) contain no reset entry point, despite floor-run-restart-persistent-closure already depending on it and the GDD explicitly naming 'encounter activation/admission state' as a required reset participant in both the Loss and Floor-run restart ownership paragraphs. Repaired by adding the missing reset acceptance/validation criteria; no dependency-edge change was needed since the edge already exists.

EV-ENEM-004 (warning, credible): Read the GDD's Loss and Floor-run restart ownership paragraphs directly — both state registry bookkeeping resets to 'the floor's initial state' with no mention of 'empty,' and the enemy-reset text separately requires each persistent enemy be returned to its authored spawn region and initial AI state (which could be active). active-enemy-registry's acceptance/validation criteria asserted an invented 'initial empty/starting state' and no criterion addressed the re-registration handoff with enemy-owned restart restoration. Repaired via remove_unique/append_unique pairs correcting the wording plus one new append_unique acceptance criterion covering the re-registration/consistency gap, keeping the fix on the registry (the natural bookkeeping-accuracy owner) rather than manufacturing a duplicate criterion on enemy-health-damage-defeat.

No findings were rejected — all four were independently verified as accurate against the GDD and the frozen candidate's actual field content before any edit was made. No new work items, features, or mechanics were invented; every change is a field-level acceptance_criteria/validation_requirements/depends_on correction on existing work items, consistent with the bounded stream-repair contract.
